applies_to: all structured payloads carrying lines; incomplete drafts may be saved but not frozen
same_connection: existing caller-owned SQLite writer transaction; no commit or rollback
snapshot_binding: current sealed actual costing context and its manifest data hash
rfq: current ready RFQ and exact row_version
confirmed current customer/contact revisions and RFQ parties
contact belongs to the exact customer
entire RFQ line set exactly once
line: unique RFQ line identity; no splitting or merging
exact SKU profile revision and manifest hash
same unit or explicit current SKU/direction-bound conversion
conversion factor uses exact rational arithmetic; no package guessing
comparison: exact pricing policy and comparison currency
exact fixed delivery date, milestone, place and time zone
not_a_token: re-resolve and compare the server certificate on each new formalization/adoption
historical_behavior: do not rewrite old payloads or committed results; A24/A25 recovery retained
old_structured_frozen_without_binding: readable history, not newly formalizable or adoptable
legacy_boundary: pre-existing unstructured lifecycle adapters are not certified complete quotations
not_certified: all dependency deadlines at physical COMMIT
split RFQ or multiple cost snapshots
